digest.component_or_area: module size management and code organization
propositions: Six files sit within 7 lines of the 800-LOC module size cap, blocking work like ticket d23e which requires 10-16 lines but has only 7 available
config.py is the most central near-cap file (16 churn/93 fan-in/793 LOC/7 headroom), and adding a single config knob costs 10-13 lines

ADR 0056 demonstrated that shape-based decomposition (absorbing verbs, flat declarations, colocated domains) relieved runner.py from 689 to 647 LOC without regrowing, but was not generalized to the next tier

Extraction moved config.py from 793 to 631 LOC and workflow_ops.py from 794 to 511 LOC, creating new modules gate_context.py (243 LOC) and decide_ops.py (349 LOC), each with seam guards asserting headroom targets
Seam tests now enforce structural defense against future regrowth since the per-function length gate was rejected by the operator as too high blast radius
Every acceptance criterion is met including resolution validation for gates/plan-review.yaml, complete env-var registry scanning, and zero edits to existing tests beyond mandated headroom assertions
